description: This file defines a React component named DocumentList that displays a list of documents with their status, size, and type. It includes another component StatusBadge for displaying document status badges. The component interacts with application context for managing document state.

methods.name: StatusBadge
methods.description: A React component that displays a badge indicating the status of a document, styled based on the status value.

methods.name: DocumentList
methods.description: Main React component that renders a list of documents with their details and allows selection or removal.
